known_blind_spots: scattered symmetric truncation (both panels, non-contiguous codes, <10%/day): all four layers silent. DP-19 layer-two pins this as unjudgeable. Only a real suspension source of truth closes it (ADR-002 §6.2).
both panels truncated for a whole span: every day looks healthy per-day; only the declared-window vs actual-coverage check catches it (2024-11 QFQ ramp is exactly this shape).
